Dispatch

Give tm8 the work before you know who should take it. The space’s Dispatcher routes the entity, prepares the context, and records its reason; it does not do the work.

routing verb no teammate picker durable request live CLI contract checked 2026-08-20
The caller chooses nothingNo teammate, model, or memory flags belong to dispatch.
The request survives deliveryAn undelivered PTY push still leaves the durable task message.
The router stops at spawnThe selected worker session performs the task; Dispatcher does not.

02The command’s honest boundary

The command acknowledges routing to the Dispatcher. It does not wait for the later worker choice, and its result does not claim that work started.

Northlake · dispatch requestCLI
tm8 session dispatch 01a09f30-7e20-7c33-8d40-2f5b7c9e1a33 \
  --note "Release work; preserve the approved voice" \
  --mutation-id dispatch-release-brief-01

Any launchable entity may be the subject. Use --force-new-task only when you intend a fresh derived task instead of reusing one open derivation.

execution.dispatch · acceptedresult shape
{
  "taskId": "01a09f21-4c00-7a11-8b2e-0d3f5a7c9e11",
  "dispatcherSessionId": "01a09f40-8a40-7e55-8f62-4b7d9e1a3c55",
  "dispatcherSpawned": false,
  "requestMessageId": "01a09f50-9b50-7f66-8a73-5c8e0f2b4d66",
  "delivery": "delivered"
}

delivery: delivered means the request reached the Dispatcher session. It does not mean a worker finished—or even that the later worker session id is known in this response.

03What remains in the graph

Dispatch is observable because routing leaves typed evidence. The prose reason lives beside those edges on the task anchor.

EvidenceShapeWhat it proves
Derived tasktask → derived_from → subjectA non-task launch subject gained the task used as the dispatch anchor.
Memory settask → remembers → memoryThe chosen memories feed the worker’s launch context after its persona working set.
Route provenancework_session → dispatched_by → work_sessionThe worker session was spawned by that Dispatcher session.
Reasonmessage → anchored_to → taskWho was chosen and why is durable on the same anchor as the work.

04Dispatch or spawn?

Dispatch

Use it when the question is “someone should do this; choose well.” Hand tm8 only the subject and an optional note.

tm8 session dispatch <subject-id>

Spawn

Use it when you already know the teammate and launch configuration. Naming the worker yourself is manual spawning, not dispatch.

tm8 session spawn …
Boundary, by designDispatcher can inspect routing context, attach memories, spawn, and reply. It does not edit the product, perform the task, create teammates, or hide an undelivered request.
  • The first dispatch in a space may be slower because the server may need to start the resident Dispatcher session and wait for it to settle.
  • Liveness is probed; a stored work_session.status alone is not trusted.
  • If delivery reports undelivered, the stored request remains recoverable on the task anchor.
